verdict.rationale: Elastic's client docs say Elasticsearch has "a wide range of official libraries and developer tools" for most popular languages, and describe a forward-compatibility policy so clients keep working against newer servers. The quickstart also invites building in "your preferred language," and a community comment points to Elastic's ecosystem of drivers. Missing for 10: the specific supported languages, detailed per-SDK documentation or feature coverage, and independent hands-on reports of building with the SDKs.
